title: When Bitcoin dips and ENSO rockets
content:
BTC: "I’m just a gentle 5% dip, chill..." 
ENSO: *hits 33.6% and screams* "Did someone say leverage?" 
Me at 3 AM: Watching both like a reality TV drama, popcorn in hand.
lesson: If a coin’s chart looks like a roller‑coaster, keep your stop‑loss tighter than your coffee mug.
question: Who else was glued to the 1‑minute chart until sunrise? Drop a 🙃 if you’re still wide‑awake!
